data.title: Window replacement appointment on 12 January 2027
data.summary: Your housing cooperative (Wohnungsbaugenossenschaft Beispielbau eG) will replace the windows in your flat on 12 January 2027, starting at 7:30 and lasting about six hours. They ask you to confirm within 10 working days of the letter date (16 December 2026) whether you can make it.
data.explanation: Your landlord is replacing all windows in Birkenallee 15. Your flat is scheduled for 12 January 2027 at 7:30, and the work takes about six hours. Please tell the cooperative within 10 working days (Werktage, Monday to Saturday except public holidays) from the letter date whether the appointment suits you. The app shows the reply date. If you don't reply, they will set a replacement appointment. You can reply by phone or email using the contact details on the letter.
